title: Dhikr Counter

elhamdulillah.name: Alhamdulillah
elhamdulillah.meaning: All praise is due to Allah

last.name: La ilaha illallah
last.meaning: There is no god but Allah

salavat.name: Salawat
salavat.meaning: O Allah, send blessings upon our Prophet Muhammad

ihlas.name: Surah Ikhlas
ihlas.meaning: Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, Allah, the Eternal Refuge.

fatiha.name: Surah Fatiha
fatiha.meaning: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds.

ayetel_kursi.name: Ayat al-Kursi
ayetel_kursi.meaning: Allah! There is no deity except Him, the Alive, the Sustainer.

hasbunallah.name: Hasbunallahu wa ni'mal wakeel
hasbunallah.meaning: Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.

lahavle.name: La hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
lahavle.meaning: There is no power nor strength except by Allah.

yunus_duasi.name: Dua of Yunus
yunus_duasi.meaning: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.

salati_tefriciye.name: Salat al-Tafrijiyyah
salati_tefriciye.meaning: Blessing for relief of all difficulties and acceptance of wishes.

kelime_i_tevhid.name: Kalima Tawhid
kelime_i_tevhid.meaning: There is no god but Allah; Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.

kelime_i_sehadet.name: Kalima Shahada
kelime_i_sehadet.meaning: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

besmele.name: Bismillah
besmele.meaning: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful.

subhanallahi_ve_bihamdihi.name: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi
subhanallahi_ve_bihamdihi.meaning: Glory be to Allah and praise Him.

subhanallahi_velazim.name: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi, SubhanAllahil-Azim
subhanallahi_velazim.meaning: Two phrases light on the tongue, heavy on the scale.

bakiyat_salihat.name: SubhanAllah walhamdulillah wa la ilaha illallah wallahu akbar
bakiyat_salihat.meaning: The enduring good deeds: glorification, praise, oneness and greatness of Allah.

tevhid_zikri.name: La ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lah
tevhid_zikri.meaning: Allah is One, without partner; His is the dominion and the praise, and He is able to do all things.

seyyidul_istigfar.name: Sayyid al-Istighfar
seyyidul_istigfar.meaning: The master supplication for forgiveness — recited morning and evening.

hasbiyallah.name: Hasbiyallahu la ilaha illa Hu
hasbiyallah.meaning: Allah is sufficient for me; there is no god but Him. In Him I put my trust.

allahumme_ecirni.name: Allahumma ajirni minan-nar
allahumme_ecirni.meaning: O Allah, protect me from the Fire.

rabbena_atina.name: Rabbana atina
rabbena_atina.meaning: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and the Hereafter, and protect us from the punishment of the Fire.

salaten_tuncina.name: Salat al-Munjiyah (Tunjina)
salaten_tuncina.meaning: The salawat recited for salvation from all calamities and hardships.

felak.name: Surah Al-Falaq
felak.meaning: I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He created.

nas.name: Surah An-Nas
nas.meaning: I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, their King and their God.

subhane_rabbiyel_azim.name: Subhana Rabbiyal-Azim
subhane_rabbiyel_azim.meaning: Glory be to my Lord, the Almighty — tasbih of ruku.

subhane_rabbiyel_ala.name: Subhana Rabbiyal-A'la
subhane_rabbiyel_ala.meaning: Glory be to my Lord, the Most High — tasbih of sujud.

subbuhun_kuddusun.name: Subbuhun Quddusun
subbuhun_kuddusun.meaning: Perfect and Holy is the Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

rabbi_zidni_ilma.name: Rabbi zidni ilma
rabbi_zidni_ilma.meaning: My Lord, increase me in knowledge. (Taha 114)

rabbisrah_li_sadri.name: Rabbi-shrah li sadri
rabbisrah_li_sadri.meaning: My Lord, expand my chest and ease my task. (Taha 25-26)

rabbena_la_tuzig.name: Rabbana la tuzigh qulubana
rabbena_la_tuzig.meaning: Our Lord! Let not our hearts deviate after You have guided us. (Al Imran 8)

ya_hayyu_ya_kayyum.name: Ya Hayyu Ya Qayyum
ya_hayyu_ya_kayyum.meaning: O Ever-Living, O Sustainer! By Your mercy I seek help.

ya_erhamer_rahimin.name: Ya Arhamar-Rahimin
ya_erhamer_rahimin.meaning: O Most Merciful of the merciful!

melikul_hakkul_mubin.name: La ilaha illallahul-Malikul-Haqqul-Mubin
melikul_hakkul_mubin.meaning: There is no god but Allah, the King, the Manifest Truth.

estagfirullah_elazim.name: Astaghfirullahal-Azim wa atubu ilayh
estagfirullah_elazim.meaning: I seek forgiveness of Allah the Almighty, the Living, the Sustainer, and repent to Him.

afv_afiyet.name: Allahumma inni as'alukal-afwa wal-afiyah
afv_afiyet.meaning: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being.

bismillahillezi.name: Bismillahilladhi la yadurru
bismillahillezi.meaning: In His name, nothing on earth or in heaven can cause harm. (3x morning and evening)

euzu_bikelimatillah.name: A'udhu bikalimatillah
euzu_bikelimatillah.meaning: I seek refuge in the perfect words of Allah from the evil of what He created.

radiytu_billahi.name: Raditu billahi Rabba
radiytu_billahi.meaning: I am pleased with Allah as Lord, Islam as religion, and Muhammad as Prophet.

adede_halkihi.name: SubhanAllahi wa bihamdihi adada khalqihi
adede_halkihi.meaning: Glory and praise to Allah as much as His creation, His pleasure, and the weight of His Throne.

salat_i_fetih.name: Salat al-Fatih
salat_i_fetih.meaning: The salawat recited for openings and relief in worldly and spiritual matters.

allahumme_entes_selam.name: Allahumma antas-Salam
allahumme_entes_selam.meaning: O Allah, You are Peace and from You comes peace — dhikr after prayer.

confirmReset: Are you sure you want to reset the dhikr counter?
footerVerse: “O you who believe! Remember Allah with much remembrance, and glorify Him morning and evening.”

dhul-jalali-wal-ikram.meaning: The Lord of Majesty and Bounty

ar-rashid.meaning: The Guide to the Right Path

dhikrLimit.title: Daily Dhikr Limit
dhikrLimit.desc3: Upgrade to Premium for unlimited dhikr.

picker.title: Pick your dhikr
picker.body: 44 ready dhikr and the Names of Allah are here. If yours is missing, type it into the search box and add it.

target.title: Set your target
target.body: 33, 99 or your own number. When you reach it the round completes and the counter starts a new one.

theme.title: Change the look
theme.body: Cycles through three themes: Beads, Tally Counter and Classic. Beads let you pick the material, the counter lets you pick the colour.

settings.title: Sound, vibration, shortcuts
settings.body: Set the click sound and vibration here. To count without looking, turn on volume-button counting or full-screen tap.
